summary: Ran check_citation on the 12 most claim-critical ref_ids from the summary/preclinical cluster (42440741, 42361626, 40816230, 42229401, 42131170, 42709484, 42630618, 42794697, 42748783, 42432192, 42479041, 42460027). All 12 returned verified=false on title-similarity grounds (my claimed titles were the harness's descriptive record labels, not exact paper titles). Semantic adjudication of fetched titles: 10/12 clearly describe the same study as claimed (42440741 = HF mitochondrial SR/meta-analysis; 42361626 = PMD clinical-development review; 40816230 = elamipretide/Barth case report, which also supports the "single case/n=1" wording; 42229401 = pharmacotherapy perspective, matching "комментарий"; 42131170 = LHON gene-therapy SR/meta-analysis; 42709484 = allotopic ND6 restores vision in a mitochondrial disease model; 42630618 = confirmed "structured review, horizon scan"; 42748783 = CaSR post-MI study, corroborating the MI-model wording; 42432192 = urolithin A/HFpEF remodeling; 42479041 = MitoQ/diabetic cardiomyopathy mtROS-TXNIP-NLRP3). Two are substantive mismatches and block approval: (a) 42794697 resolves to "Mitochondrial Quality Control in Inherited Mitochondrial Cardiomyopathy: Convergent Pathobiology and a Testable Therapeutic Framework" — not a MitoQ meta-analysis in PMD, so the "meta-analysis could not assess MitoQ efficacy" claim fails; (b) 42460027 resolves to a sodium selenite sepsis-cardiomyopathy paper, not MitoQ, so the cluster's "MitoQ in septic cardiomyopathy" attribution is wrong. Separately, four numeric claims have no provenance in the extracted record data (SMD 0.42/95% CI 0.31–0.53, RR 2.38/0.62/0.60 for 42440741; 159/110 registered studies for 42361626; "two FDA approvals within a year" for 42229401; n=175 for 42131170) and must be removed per the no-unprovenanced-numbers rule. Directional, phase and standard-of-care (idebenone) claims otherwise match the records; the comparative matrix is truncated mid-row. Verdict: NOT approved — 9 blocking findings, REMOVE actions first.

findings.issue: Quantitative effect estimates 'SMD 0,42; 95% ДИ 0,31–0,53' (LVEF), 'RR 2,38' (NYHA), 'RR 0,62' (all-cause mortality), 'RR 0,60' (HF hospitalizations) do not appear anywhere in the extracted record for 42440741 (record carries only outcome names with positive directions); numbers have no provenance. The citation check (fetched: 'Therapeutic targeting of mitochondrial dysfunction in heart failure: a systematic review & meta-analysis of clinical outcomes') confirms the study identity and the directional claims, but not any magnitude.

'159 зарегистрированных исследований (110 интервенционных)' — the counts do not appear in the extracted record for 42361626 (record: registered studies across PMD subtypes: unclear; late-stage trial outcomes: negative; regulatory authorizations: positive); no provenance. Fetched title ('Clinical development in primary mitochondrial diseases at a translational inflection point...') does not itself confirm a systematic ClinicalTrials.gov survey either.

'два одобрения в течение года' — the specific count (two approvals within one year) is not in the extracted record for 42229401 (record: 'FDA approvals for mitochondrial disease therapies: positive') and not in the fetched title ('Is an emerging pharmacotherapeutic era for rare mitochondrial diseases here?'); number has no provenance.

'(n=175)' for the rAAV2/2-ND4 phase-1 meta-analysis does not appear in the extracted record for 42131170 (record: best-corrected visual acuity: positive; responder rates: neutral; adverse events: neutral); sample size has no provenance.

'значимым улучшением BCVA' and 'без связанных с лечением смертей' overstate the record: 42131170 carries BCVA:positive (no significance flag in the extracted data), responder rates:neutral, adverse events:neutral; neither a significance claim nor an explicit 'no treatment-related deaths' statement is in the record.

'значимо восстановила зрительную функцию у мышей ND6P25L' — the ND6P25L mouse-strain label appears neither in the extracted record nor in the fetched title ('Allotopic Expression of ND6 Restores Vision in a Mitochondrial Disease Model'), and no significance flag exists in the record (visual function: positive).

Claim 'мета-анализ по MitoQ в ПМЗ вообще не смог оценить эффективность (42794697)' fails the citation check: the identifier resolves to 'Mitochondrial Quality Control in Inherited Mitochondrial Cardiomyopathy: Convergent Pathobiology and a Testable Therapeutic Framework' — a pathobiology/therapeutic-framework paper, not a MitoQ meta-analysis in primary mitochondrial diseases. verified=false with substantive (not merely label-level) title mismatch; study type and focus of the claim are unsupported.

The septic cardiomyopathy arm is attributed to MitoQ ('MitoQ в моделях диабетической и септической кардиомиопатии'), but 42460027 resolves to 'Sodium selenite attenuates sepsis-induced cardiac inflammation and oxidative injury by regulating TXN2/TXNIP/NLRP3 signaling and ferroptosis' — the agent is sodium selenite, not MitoQ. verified=false with agent-level mismatch; the outcomes (TXN2/TXNIP/NLRP3/ferroptosis) belong to the selenite study.
The matrix is truncated mid-row: the 42361626 line breaks off inside a cell ('...systematic survey of ClinicalTrials.g'), so the comparative matrix is incomplete as delivered.
